Exposure at a prepubertal index age, attached to every visit of a child

Source: R/traj.R
wgh_index_exposure.Rd

Picks one visit per child in an index window (for example the earliest visit at or before 11 years in boys and 9 years in girls, the definition used in the trajectory, pubertal spurt and height prediction studies) and attaches its value of var (and optionally a category) to the whole child record.

Usage

wgh_index_exposure(
  x,
  var = "baz",
  max_age = c(Male = 11, Female = 9),
  min_age = 5,
  pick = c("earliest", "latest", "nearest"),
  categories = NULL,
  name = "index"
)

Arguments

x

Growth data.

var

Exposure variable, for example "baz".

max_age

Named vector of the latest index age by sex.

min_age

Earliest age allowed for the index visit.

pick

"earliest", "latest" or "nearest" (to max_age).

categories

Optional function turning the exposure value into a category, for example wgh_bmi_category.

name

Prefix of the new columns.

Value

x restricted to children with an index visit, with columns <name>_value, <name>_age and, when categories is given, <name>_cat.

Examples

ix <- wgh_index_exposure(growdat, "baz", categories = wgh_bmi_category)
table(ix$index_cat[!duplicated(ix$pid)])
#> 
#>   Thinness     Normal Overweight    Obesity 
#>         35        922        386        259
